parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow, typically for hot water.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow, typically for cold water.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Frame (Right Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support for the right handle.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the right handle to the sink surface and connects to internal plumbing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Frame (Left Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left base frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support for the left handle.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the left handle to the sink surface and connects to internal plumbing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the main spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the mixed water from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally depending on the faucet design.

parts.name: Frame (Spout Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the base frame of the spout, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and sealing for the spout.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout to the sink and internal plumbing, ensuring stability and preventing leaks.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.
